The podcast aims to encourage listeners to live out genuine Christianity.

assumptions.text: Genuine Christianity is distinct from superficial expressions of faith.
The audience values authentic Christian living and is receptive to encouragement in that direction.
Music serves as an appropriate transition into the podcast’s spiritual tone.
